scripts.docker:up:local: cross-env API_PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:3002 APP_PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:3001 docker-compose --profile http -f docker-compose.local.yaml --env-file .env.local rm -f db-push && cross-env API_PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:3002 APP_PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:3001 docker-compose --profile http -f docker-compose.local.yaml --env-file .env.local up -d
scripts.docker:start:local: pnpm run docker:build:local && pnpm run docker:up:local && pnpm run docker:logs:local
scripts.docker:up:local:https: cross-env API_PUBLIC_URL=https://localhost:3002 APP_PUBLIC_URL=https://localhost:3001 docker-compose --profile https -f docker-compose.local.yaml --env-file .env.local rm -f db-push && cross-env API_PUBLIC_URL=https://localhost:3002 APP_PUBLIC_URL=https://localhost:3001 VITE_APP_PUBLIC_URL=https://localhost:3003 docker-compose --profile https -f docker-compose.local.yaml --env-file .env.local up -d
scripts.docker:trust-caddy: docker-compose --profile https -f docker-compose.local.yaml --env-file .env.local cp caddy-https:/data/caddy/pki/authorities/local/root.crt .\caddy-local-root.crt && certutil -user -addstore Root .\caddy-local-root.crt
scripts.docker:start:local:https: pnpm run docker:build:local:https && pnpm run docker:up:local:https && pnpm run docker:trust-caddy && pnpm run docker:logs:local:https
scripts.docker:start:stage: pnpm run docker:build:stage && pnpm run docker:up:stage
scripts.docker:start:production: pnpm run docker:build:production && pnpm run docker:up:production
scripts.format: oxfmt --write apps shared package.json turbo.json docker-compose.local.yaml docker-compose.stage.yaml docker-compose.production.yaml CONTEXT.md
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check apps shared package.json turbo.json docker-compose.local.yaml docker-compose.stage.yaml docker-compose.production.yaml CONTEXT.md
